newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Domestic support keeps Russian shares steady.
newsitem.headline: Domestic support keeps Russian shares steady.

text.p: Russian traders and small clients supported leading shares, which stayed steady on Monday despite a lack of orders from the West, traders said.
The Russian Trading System index of 24 shares ticked up 0.11 percent to 186.24 on $8.73 million market turnover.
"It is progress that the levels most shares had reached this summer did not change much," said Andrei Kukk, chief trader at Rinaco-Plus brokerage, remarking on the domestic support.
Traders forecast a thin market with little fluctuation as investors held positions through the Orthodox Christmas on January 14.

Spreads widened early on Monday, a signal that the market was slowing down, despite news that the International Monetary Fund had agreed to release a delayed tranche of its $10 billion loan to Russia.
Mosenergo, one of the most liquid shares, closed with a spread of 0.6 cents at $0.969/$0.975, slightly wider than a usual 0.5 cents.
The State Duma lower house of parliament also passed the 1997 budget at a first reading on Sunday, a working day in Russia.
"The market is very quiet, there are practically no orders," said Victor Pitaleff, a trader from Renaissance Capital.
Volga Tanker was one of the gain leaders of the day, rising to $3.30 from $2.60 on December 11, when it was last traded.

Kukk said the share was in demand while the supply was almost non-existent, which is often the case in secondary, less liquid shares towards which some experienced investors have headed in the last month or so.
UES was flat at $0.0825 from Sunday's close, despite news that a scheduled auction of 8.5 percent of company shares set for the end of the month had been cancelled.
"It is hard to frighten investors in this market," said Pitaleff, referring to UES and adding that the market was generally sluggish.
Gazprom rose to $0.327 from $0.323, Norilsk Nickel edged up to $5.00 from $4.97 and Irkutskenergo was up to $0.12 after $0.112.
